The '''YV-560 light freighter''' was an exploration class [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] made by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. Similar in design to CEC's [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]], the YV-560 was slightly smaller, with a 30.1 [[Meter/Legends|meter]] length and a 22.4 meter saucer diameter.<ref name="ETU" />

YV-560 freighters had room for 5 passengers and 2 crew, with approximately 40 [[Metric ton/Legends|tons]] of cargo space and enough [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] storage for 8 [[Standard month/Legends|months]]. Its compartmentalized cargo bays could be individually sealed by bulkheads in case of serious damage to the ship.<ref name="ETU" />

YV-560 operators could easily survey [[Planet/Legends|planets]] from orbit, due to the long-range sensor capabilities of the numerous antennae in its prow. The YV-560 also featured a dorsal mounted twin medium cannon, a powerful onboard scientific [[Computer/Legends|computer]], a class 2 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], and a class 15 backup hyperdrive.<ref name="ETU" />
